angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 282,454 km at 28.57 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 34.9988 +/- 0.0282 mas (same row, RUWE 1.33): 28.57 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.406 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Murgas et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Wolf 327 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..83M/abstract): 282,454 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.405 +/- 0.019 solar masses from Murgas et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Wolf 327 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..83M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3542 +/- 70 K from Murgas et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Wolf 327 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..83M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Murgas et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Wolf 327 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..83M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wolf-327.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.828, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
